set.body:
Nine items. The single worked example five separate beads independently asked for, plus everything that currently prevents a reader from running what they are shown.

WHY SECOND: the exemplars/haxby2001 directory already contains the real-data journey, so most of this is connecting it to the documentation rather than building it. bd-01KZZXTKJKCH0TJFFWP06B7G4Y (in the existing p0 slice) surfaces the rMVPA parity result; this epic makes the surrounding narrative runnable.

CHEAPEST FIRST, both verified and both minutes of work:
  bd-01KZY94REFFH9DQDJG7TD2J7XJ  two chunks change include=FALSE to echo=TRUE
  bd-01KZY96KKH0X14EC62S2VX2RV9  one sentence connecting geometry to the second-moment matrix G

ACCEPTANCE: every code block shown to a reader executes; every example ends on an interpretable claim rather than an unlabelled table; the neuroim2 round trip runs from mask to NeuroVol in one documented sequence.
